title: Sleepiness and Sloth
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 1.16 Linked Discourses 1.16
  • 2. Nandanavagga 2. The Garden of Delight

Niddātandīsutta Sleepiness and Sloth

“Niddā tandī vijambhitā, “Sleepiness, sloth, and yawning, Aratī bhattasammado; discontent, and grogginess after eating: Etena nappakāsati, because of this the noble path Ariyamaggo idha pāṇinan”ti. doesn’t shine for creatures here.”

“Niddaṁ tandiṁ vijambhitaṁ, “Sleepiness, sloth, and yawning, Aratiṁ bhattasammadaṁ; discontent, and grogginess after eating: Vīriyena naṁ paṇāmetvā, when this is energetically fended off, Ariyamaggo visujjhatī”ti. the noble path is purified.”
